facts.claim: Azarshahr county has 150 hectares of garlic cultivation and produces over 8,400 tons, ranking first in East Azerbaijan province.
In agricultural year 1404-1405, approximately 320.3 hectares of agricultural land in East Azerbaijan province were allocated to garlic cultivation, yielding nearly 18,000 tons.
Drip tape irrigation can save up to 30-40% of water usage and increases uniformity of bulb growth and yield per hectare.
Drip tapes with emitter spacing of 10-15 cm are ideal for garlic cultivation.
Standard pressure for proper and uniform operation of drip tape irrigation system should be in range 0.5 to 2 atmospheres.
Drip tape emitter flow rate typically varies from 0.8 to 3.8 liters per hour.
